note: Legend portraits, the executioner (Lead via Strategy, Dom 2026-09-27). One FLUX.1 [dev] text-to-image per rung, from the source text in src/legends.ts; never from a film, comic or game depiction. Final size 512x512. `style` is appended to every subject. The prompt is `framing` + `subject` + `style`.
framing: Close-up head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large and filling the upper half of the square frame, cropped at the chest, of
style: Dark painterly realism like an old oil painting, ancient brutal ceremonial tone, grounded proportions, muted palette of bronze, iron, bone, leather, stone and ash, a single low warm torchlight from one side leaving the rest in deep shadow, dark smoky near-black background, no saturated colours, no glowing effects, no text, no border, no frame.

legends.name: Headsman
legends.subject: a medieval executioner, a black hood over his face with only the eyes showing, bare heavy shoulders, a leather apron, a wooden block behind him.

legends.name: Ankou
legends.subject: the Ankou of Breton folklore, a tall gaunt figure in a wide black hat and long cloak, a skeletal face, holding a scythe with its blade turned outward, a creaking wooden cart on a foggy lane behind him.

legends.name: Charon
legends.subject: Charon the ferryman of the dead, a grim old man with a filthy tangled grey beard and burning eyes, a ragged cloak, a long pole, the dark river Styx behind him.

legends.name: Hel
legends.subject: Hel the Norse queen of the dead, a woman whose face is half living pale and half dark and dead, long grey hair, a hooded cloak, the gloomy hall of Helheim behind her.

legends.name: Anubis
legends.subject: Anubis the jackal-headed Egyptian guardian of the dead, a black jackal head with tall ears on a man's body, a gold and lapis collar, a set of scales behind him.

legends.name: Ereshkigal
legends.subject: Ereshkigal the Mesopotamian queen of the underworld, a stern goddess in a tall horned crown of the old Sumerian style, dark hair, a heavy fringed robe, a gate of dark stone behind her.

legends.name: The Morrigan
legends.subject: the Morrigan, the Irish war goddess, a wild-haired woman with a pale fierce face, a black feathered cloak, crows on her shoulder, a river ford at dusk behind her.

legends.name: Arawn
legends.subject: Arawn king of Annwn from the Mabinogion, a regal grey-clad huntsman with a grey cloak and a silver circlet, a pack of white hounds with red ears in a misty forest behind him.

legends.name: Thanatos
legends.subject: Thanatos, Greek god of death, a winged bearded man with a calm sorrowful face, dark wings folded, an inverted torch in his hand, as on an ancient Greek funerary relief.

legends.name: The Reaper
legends.subject: the Grim Reaper of the medieval Dance of Death, a skeleton in a ragged hooded black shroud, holding a scythe, a medieval graveyard behind him, as in the old woodcuts.
